title: Palace: No new tax to offset system-loss VAT revenue

blocks.text: MANILA – The government is not looking to impose a new tax to make up for an estimated PHP10 billion in annual revenue losses following the removal of value-added tax (VAT) on allowable electricity system-loss charges, Malacañang said Tuesday. Palace Press Officer Claire Castro said the government would instead rely on tax administration and existing revenue reforms to make up for the potential reduction in VAT collections. “Sa ngayon ay wala pong napag-uusapan kung mayroong pang dagdag na buwis na ipapataw, dahil hindi po iyan ang concern sa ngayon ng pamahalaan (For now, there are no discussions about imposing any additional […]...
